_about: The city objects palette (docs/design/city-objects-plan.md 3.2). Step 1 (solid classes) starts it with the classes alone: one row per class of collider face, the answer the car gets (H hard, S smash, P push, R ride, G ghost) and a note. Every class answers H in step 1, which is today's behaviour. game/scripts/solidity.gd reads it; map_builder.gd _solid and the dressing scripts' bodies name these ids (game/tools/check_solids.gd).

classes.note: an OpenStreetMap building's walls, the first 5 m (map_builder _build_buildings)
a GUGiK LoD2 building's steep triangles (map_builder _build_lod2)
an OpenStreetMap kiosk, shed, carport, roof, service hut or any outline under 30 m2 (the census's split), or a researched small building (small_buildings.gd)
a barrier line of kind fence, slab or open railing (map_builder _build_barriers)
a barrier line of kind hedge
a barrier line of kind wall, and the Old Town's city walls
a wall or fence the bake marked as a stair's balustrade (the line's st, tools/object_fixes.py)
an open railing that is no barrier line: the fence along the railway cutting's top
retaining walls, the cutting's parapets, the viaduct's closed bays, the water's edge
a wall inside a tunnel, from its floor to over a bus
a tunnel portal's headwall
a deck's parapet or railing over a drop, and the guard rails on decks
a guard rail on the ground
bridge piers and portal legs, and the Tamka footbridge's pier and deck
a railway platform's or tram island's solid sides
a parked car's box
a tram or bus shelter's box
street details, monuments, park pieces and a square's blocks and cubes (the dressing scripts' bodies)
an invisible wall across a gap a car would wedge into (map_builder _bridge_pockets)
a garage door at a ramp's top, or a car park mouth's barrier arm
a landmark site's walls (landmarks.gd), and the Ratusz Arsenal tower
the invisible walls at the map's edge and the roadworks that close the roads there
